description: Input boundary catalog for DZ harness — every external input surface and its validator.

boundaries.description: Raw argv from the `dz` CLI — parsed by the internal parseArgs function that splits positional, --key value, and --flag tokens.
JSON-RPC tool call parameters received by the MCP server — each tool's inputSchema is a Zod schema that validates before the handler runs.
Filesystem path to the skills directory — resolved to an absolute path and checked with existsSync before any I/O.
Skill id and asset paths used during emit — assertSafeId rejects empty, dot-dot, and slash-containing ids; normalizeAssetPath rejects traversal.
The --preset value supplied to `dz init` — validated by isPresetName which checks against the PRESETS const object.
The --target value supplied to `dz init` / `dz verify` — validated by isTargetName which checks against the TARGETS const object.
The unique record id for memory backend put/query — typed as string in the MemoryRecord interface; no further runtime validation beyond TypeScript.
The .agentic-qe/config.yaml file parsed by `dz doctor` — validated by yaml.parse with a structural check (typeof parsed?.project === 'string').
